_comment: Residue identities asserted by the legacy dataset, checked against the actual UniProt sequence. Produced by the curation workflow's independent verifier, which retrieved each sequence and sliced it at the cited position. 'convention' records whether the number is canonical UniProt numbering (including signal peptide) or mature-chain numbering.
_method: UniProt sequence retrieval + direct position lookup

numbering_convention_errors.asserted: AChE CAS (Trp84, Phe330, Tyr121) & PAS (Trp286, Tyr72, Tyr341)
numbering_convention_errors.problem: two organisms' numbering conventions inside a single parenthesis
numbering_convention_errors.resolution: Trp84/Phe330/Tyr121 are Torpedo californica numbering; the human equivalents are Trp86/Phe338/Tyr124 in mature-chain numbering. Trp286/Tyr72/Tyr341 are human MATURE-chain numbering; in canonical P22303 numbering (SIGNAL 1-31, CHAIN 32-614) they are positions 317, 103 and 372. Every residue annotation must be re-derived against one declared reference.

verified_correct.convention: canonical numbering; these are the mature-chain Trp286/Tyr72/Tyr341
